lamps.steady: Restraint system malfunction. Drive carefully and have it checked immediately at a qualified workshop.
Reminds the driver and front passenger to fasten their seat belts.
lamps.flashing: Driver or passenger belt is unfastened while moving, or objects are on passenger seat. Fasten belt.

lamps.steady: The occupant presence reminder is deactivated. Switch it on.
The occupant presence reminder is malfunctioning. Note messages on driver's display.
Drive system power output is reduced. Note messages on the driver's display.
There is a malfunction in the drive system. Note messages on driver's display.
There is an electrical malfunction. Note messages on the driver's display.
Brake system malfunction. Drive carefully and have it checked immediately at a qualified workshop.
Brake system malfunction. Drive carefully and have it checked immediately at a qualified workshop.
Brake force boosting malfunction or low brake fluid. Stop safely immediately and consult a qualified workshop. Do not drive.
Brake force boosting malfunction or low brake fluid. Stop safely immediately and consult a qualified workshop. Do not drive.
ABS is malfunctioning. Wheels may lock during braking. Drive carefully and have it checked at a workshop.
ESP is malfunctioning. Drive carefully and have ESP checked at a qualified specialist workshop.
lamps.flashing: One or more wheels have reached grip limits. Adapt driving style to road conditions.

lamps.steady: ESP is deactivated. Drive carefully and only deactivate it as long as required.
Distance to the vehicle in front is too small. Be prepared to brake immediately.
A malfunction has occurred in AIRMATIC. Note the messages on the driver's display.
AIRMATIC malfunction. Driving characteristics have changed. Consult a qualified specialist workshop immediately.

lamps.lamp: Tire pressure monitoring system warning lamp
lamps.steady: Tire pressure loss detected in at least one tire. Stop safely, check and adjust tire pressure.
lamps.flashing: Tire pressure monitoring system is malfunctioning. Have it checked at a qualified workshop.

lamps.steady: The supply voltage is connected.
Overtemperature detected. Charging performance is reduced or stopped.
lamps.flashing: Overtemperature at the mains plug. The charging process is stopped.

lamps.steady: Power supply or vehicle malfunction. Reset charging cable unit or replace socket.
lamps.flashing: Charging cable malfunction. Cannot charge. Reset the charging cable operating unit.

lamps.steady: Vehicle socket is unlocked. You can insert or remove the charging cable.
lamps.flashing: Disconnection or malfunction during locking or unlocking.

lamps.steady: The charging process is completed.
lamps.flashing: The vehicle is charging with active energy flow.

lamps.steady: The charging process is paused.
lamps.flashing: A connection to the charging station is being established.
A malfunction has occurred in the vehicle. Charging is not possible.

lamps.lamp: Blind Spot Assist outside mirror warning lamp
lamps.steady: A vehicle is detected in the warning range.
lamps.flashing: Vehicle detected in warning range and turn signal is on. Double warning tone sounds.
